dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #Great job, {NICKNAME}. Now, look at what I can do!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Dvalin used to be my friend... I still regard him as such.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: We used to listen to the songs of the wind and sing Ode to the Dandelion together...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: That's why I remember him as someone gentle.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Huh? Of course, you're already my friend.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Mondstadt is famous for its wine. It's the city's most prized treasure, I'd say.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Its dandelion wine is the best!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Actually, the scent of dandelion in the wind alone is enough to get you drunk.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Ah, I almost forgot that you're underage. Such a shame...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I should prepare to meet my old friend.
